about: On the session entity of a change-appearance session: the character being edited and the definition entity. Script Extender: CCDefinitionChangeAppearance.

evidence.says: serializer bg3.exe@25605617+0x9BCFB0/0x9BD160 member 1: entity writer bg3.exe@25605617+0x4017090 at +0 (global offset = 0); macOS ctor dup of 0xFFC0000000000000 (null handles) over +0..+0x10. Neighbours definition::FullRespecComponent/RespecComponent have (Character, Respec) handles here.
serializer member 2: entity writer at +8; macOS ctor null handle.
the game's executable keeps this type name among its ECS type names (gatekit symbols types)

in a change-appearance session (Osi.StartChangeAppearance on the host of a running level) the handle at +0x0 is the host's entity and the one at +0x8 is the entity that carries CCChangeAppearanceDefinition and CCDefinitionCommon
